verdict.rationale: Brex's authentication docs describe admins creating named API tokens in the dashboard and choosing the data-access level as scopes, so a least-privilege credential can be issued for an agent [brex-docs-2, brex-docs-26]. The official MCP server shows these credentials are meant for AI assistants to act on the account [brex-docs-3]. Missing for 10: detail on how fine-grained the scopes are (e.g., read-only vs. write per resource), agent-specific or short-lived credentials, documented rotation/revocation, and independent hands-on corroboration.
